name: Auditory Scene Analysis
citation: Bregman, A.S. (1990). Auditory scene analysis: The perceptual organization of sound. MIT Press.

constructs.description: Perceptual grouping of acoustic elements into coherent streams based on frequency proximity, temporal continuity, and timbre similarity. Core mechanism for parsing complex auditory scenes.
Low-level heuristics for stream formation: onset synchrony, harmonic relationships, spectral continuity, and amplitude comodulation. Integrate at A1/A2 levels.
Selective attention to one acoustic stream (figure) while suppressing competing streams (ground). Enables speech intelligibility in noise and acoustic privacy perception.

rejection_rationale: Strongest deferred candidate at 1.4% template coverage. Needs ~120 new templates to reach 60% coverage threshold. Path forward: Prioritize ASA template development in the auditory domain expansion. Should be first promoted when template mass is sufficient.
